name: Engtex Group Berhad
overview: 2026年可获取的公告主要为股份拆细/附加上市、股息除权、股东大会及季度业绩，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增8.5%，净利润同比增335.5%。
overview_en: The announcements available for 2026 mainly cover share subdivision/additional listings, dividend ex-date, general meetings and quarterly results; no expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract awards were disclosed for the business segments. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 8.5% year-on-year and net profit rose 335.5% year-on-year.
